tagline: Timed by hand, one at a time
sector: An independent mechanical watch house making five references in small runs, sold direct and through two dealers.
founded_place_size: A studio of eight in Chicago, Illinois; a Swiss-trained watchmaker and a regulator who times every piece by hand.
about: Lunara builds mechanical watches in small runs and regulates each one by hand before it ships. We sell presence, finish and the credibility of a named regulator, not a colour or a trend. Every piece leaves with its own certificate, and the pictures have to read as confidence.
audience: Collector-literate buyers, 35 to 60, who judge a watch on form, finish and the hand behind it.
price_positioning: Four to twelve thousand dollars a piece, positioned as independent horology: above fashion watchmaking and below the grand houses.
typography: A refined serif with small caps for the wordmark and reference names, and a neat grotesque for specifications. The certificate reads formal and calm.
voice: Exact, understated, collector to collector. Example line: 'Five references. Each one regulated by hand and signed.'
brand_assets_status: We have last season's certificate as it went to the printer and an approved wording note. The timing line is fixed and cannot be reworded, and the featured reference moves each season.
values: One committed warm single-tone treatment with fine grain across the whole campaign, with a single true-colour dial frame kept so a customer can judge the finish honestly.
